summary: Export OMP admission fallback diagnostics and bounded counters by routing their observability code to the local observation log

replay.detail: Existing replicated diagnostics are retained; no historical claims are replayed into the local observation log.

schema.detail: No field, table or stored-format changes.

rules.detail: New omp-channel-admission-fallback diagnostics use the existing code-based local observation routing instead of replicated claims. Checkpoint rules and their digest are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Older members continue replicating their diagnostics; upgraded writers record this observability-only code locally for OTLP export. Admission behavior is unchanged.

recovery.detail: Rolling back restores replicated routing for new diagnostics without changing existing records.
